title: My First Novel
subtitle: A Thrilling Adventure
description: A gripping tale of adventure and discovery. When protagonist faces impossible odds, they must use everything they've learned to survive. This novel combines heart-pounding action with deep character development in a near-future setting where technology and humanity collide.

title: My Second Novel
subtitle: The Story Continues
description: The sequel that raises the stakes. Returning characters face new challenges as the world they thought they saved begins to unravel. With higher stakes and deeper mysteries, this second installment delivers on every promise of the first.
